title: Mofka as a Foundation for Workflow Provenance
summary: Mofka's persistent event-streaming model provides the infrastructure for HPC workflow provenance systems, enabling capture of data movement and computational events that can be queried and audited. Provenance-focused systems reference Mofka as a candidate broker for provenance message transport in tightly coupled HPC environments.
